about_the_game:
Ready for a taste of a retro adventure? Join Gumball in Trick-or-Treat Land, a JRPG that’s a love letter to the Game Boy era. Getting home shouldn't be this hard, but for a gumball who's just crash-landed, you take what you can get. A local Scarecrow can send you back, but his magic is busted. What starts as a simple errand becomes a quest to find the Hallowed Patches.

But something is also wrong in the land itself: a shadowy force known only as the Chaos Sweets has usurped the competitive spirit of Trick-or-Treat Land and seeks to turn all candy into coal. To find the patches, you'll have to deal with everyone from cranky vegetables to ghoulish mob bosses. Luckily, you won't be alone. You'll convince a few local misfits to join your party and help even the odds on your journey to restore the joy of trick-or-treating.

In this free demo, you'll explore the first part of an immersive overworld, cast spells, and brew potions. You'll get a taste of the unique, turn-based Trick-or-Treating battle system and start your main quest. While the overworld puzzles are straightforward, the real challenge lies in the turn-based combat. It's a game that is designed to be lighthearted, but challenging enough to appeal to all ages!
